implementation_mapping: H_causal_temporal_ledger implements the selected Intervention-Indexed Dual-Timeline Causal Ledger

discriminating_ablation.name: remove_bind_requirement
discriminating_ablation.negative_control: Unimodal-only bed should show ablation delta ~0 (mechanism idle, not harmful).
discriminating_ablation.pass_criterion_for_mechanism_value: On pre-registered cross-modal disambiguation bed, full H minus ablated H mean paired effect lower 95% CI >0 and effect >= SESOI 0.05, and full H minus equal-resource S2 same criterion; else mechanism null.
discriminating_ablation.procedure: Keep streams and projection but allow decide/knowledge to use unimodal digests and modality labels without bind tokens; disable co_temporal/same_object enforcement.

api: decide() -> {continue_goal, cited_bind_tokens, uncertainty} requiring non-empty cited_bind_tokens when multimodal evidence present
executable_bounded_prototype.bounded_fixture_sketch: Three packets within 0.01s: video object track centroid shift, audio onset, speech segment; bind succeeds; causal edge push->door-angle attached to bind token; counterfactual holds hinge fixed; decision continues old-project citing bind token. Corruption of audio payload changes feature_digest and must break bind or raise uncertainty. Decision without bind when multimodal packets exist must refuse.
executable_bounded_prototype.determinism: sorted keys, content digests, pure functions; same inputs => same bind_graph head digest
executable_bounded_prototype.language_runtime: Python/NumPy only; tensor_required=false; llm_required=false; training_required=false for prototype

failure_modes: Binding heuristics over-merge unrelated modalities (false same_object edges).
Under-merge when timing jitter exceeds window (missed binds).
Degenerates to placeholder if decide() ignores cited_bind_tokens.
Geometric compatibility too weak for 3D (centroid-only).
Resource growth of streams without compaction under long horizon.
Equal-resource S2 may still match if bed does not force cross-modal disambiguation.

how_it_differs_from_existing_candidates.vs_C: Event chain alone does not force cross-modal bind tokens as the unit of causal state.
how_it_differs_from_existing_candidates.vs_E: Generic property graph of objects/relations is not timing-and-feature bind of modality streams.
how_it_differs_from_existing_candidates.vs_G: Not action-conditioned next-event-kind prediction errors; predictions attach to bind tokens.
how_it_differs_from_existing_candidates.vs_I_S2: Decisions must cite binds under multimodal evidence; semantic state must change when binds change.
how_it_differs_from_existing_candidates.vs_placeholder_H: Planes are topological views over binds, not present/past/counterfactual integer counters on shared projection.

proposal.mechanism: Own per-modality observation streams and form first-class bind tokens only when (1) feature digests are content-derived, (2) timestamps fall inside a declared binding window, and (3) geometric/telemetry compatibility checks pass. Causal edges, counterfactual planes, goals, knowledge admission, and mechanism_decision.continue_goal may reference only bind tokens (or explicitly unbound residuals with raised uncertainty). Unbound unimodal labels cannot license knowledge or action. Temporal planes are derived from bind-token topology (past=committed binds, present=open binds, counterfactual=cloned plane with declared changed/held_fixed), not event-kind counters.

resource_costs.models: optional later adapters only after component tournament; not identity owners
resource_costs.space: streams + bind_graph + projection; expect modest multiple of current ~11KB checkpoint when windows retained; cap open segments
resource_costs.time: O(k * w) bind checks per observation batch (k streams in window w); fixture target <10ms on laptop CPU

state_representation.bind_graph: nodes=segment refs; edges in {co_temporal, same_object, causal, counterfactual_link} with confidence and evidence digests
state_representation.contract_projection: 16 external contracts projected deterministically from bind_graph + epistemic/goal overlays; identity and unfinished goals live in projection and checkpoint
state_representation.exclusions: transient model context; hidden labels; modality tags without features
state_representation.planes: past/present/counterfactual subgraph views projected from bind_graph, not integer counters
state_representation.streams: append-only per-modality segments {segment_id, modality, t, content_digest, feature_digest, features, provenance}

proposal.testable_admission_gate: Implement prototype behind ArchitecturePrototype candidate_id H_sensorimotor_causal_bind; require interface_conformance, mechanism_ablation_detected on remove_bind_requirement, distinct semantic_state_digest from I under differing binds, and SESOI-positive equal-resource pilot vs S2 and full_transcript_replay on a frozen multimodal bed before any selection change.
proposal.title: Sensorimotor Causal Bind Ledger

discriminating_ablation.expected_signature: Family static-object-under-pan accuracy drops by >= SESOI for ablation relative to full H; raw-motion ablation invents spurious object motion edges
discriminating_ablation.keep_constant: event count, contracts, goals, non-motion state, compute budget
discriminating_ablation.name: residual_object_motion_binding_off
discriminating_ablation.remove: ego-motion residual path; commit tracks from raw temporal frame energy only

bounded_fixture_sketch: Ingest 5-frame video with camera pan and static object (generated array).
Require H to keep one track bound to object_key door across frames using residual, not raw motion.
Open counterfactual plane with camera translation zeroed; predict track shift differs; refuse actual writeback.
Checkpoint/restore; identity and unfinished goals preserved; motion_ledger restored.
Ablation run disables residual binding; expect track fragmentation or false motion edges.
executable_bounded_prototype.reuse: Reuse final_revision_sensorium video residual/camera proxy features as inputs, but store them in H-owned motion_ledger rather than only perceptual memory digests.
executable_bounded_prototype.runtime: NumPy-only, no LLM, no tensor training, deterministic
executable_bounded_prototype.training_requirement: none for prototype; optional later component tournament for learned flow/depth

failure_modes: 2D translation ego-motion proxy fails under rotation, zoom, or depth change; residual confounded.
Over-segmentation of tracks creates false objects (ontology pollution).
Counterfactual/predictive plane leakage into actual knowledge if seal bugs exist.
Decorative complexity: if H only records motion features but decisions match I/S2, tournament must reject H.
Non-transfer: motion-family gains with null on non-motion families => organ, not kernel.
Resource blowup if unbounded tracks/edges without capacity limits.

mechanism.decision_rule: Prefer actions that reduce residual-track uncertainty on active goals when inquiry uncertainty exceeds threshold; otherwise continue unfinished goals. Activation remains false.
operators: open_plane(kind in {predictive, counterfactual}, interventions, held_fixed) -> plane_id
admit_plane_learning(plane_id, held_out_before, held_out_after, retention) -> actual write or refuse
mechanism.summary: On each multimodal observation, estimate camera motion proxy and residual object motion; update track trajectories only from residual energy; bind tracks to world objects; maintain three sealed causal planes (actual, predictive, counterfactual) whose edges carry temporal validity intervals; decisions at logical time t may read actual edges covering t plus explicitly opened predictive/counterfactual branches with content-addressed receipts.

proposal.originality_statement: Not a rename of C (event sourcing), E (property graph), G (kind-transition prediction), or placeholder plane counters. Distinct mechanism is ego-motion residual binding into sealed temporal causal planes that own track-to-object trajectories and gate actual-plane writeback.

relation_to_existing_candidates.vs_C_event_sourced: C appends typed events; MB-TCL adds motion-owned state and plane seals that change queries under ablation.
relation_to_existing_candidates.vs_E_graph_dynamical: E counts nodes/edges from world ops; MB-TCL builds edges from residual tracks with temporal validity, not payload graph decoration.
relation_to_existing_candidates.vs_G_predictive_world_model: G predicts next event kind heuristically; MB-TCL predicts residual track geometry in open planes with writeback refusal.
relation_to_existing_candidates.vs_placeholder_H: Placeholder only increments plane counters; MB-TCL requires residual_track_updates and refused_writebacks for mechanism_active.

resource_costs.compute: O(T*H*W) per video observation for frame diffs/translations (same order as current sensorium) plus O(E + K) plane queries for edges E and tracks K
resource_costs.equal_resource_rule: Match event opportunities, tool access, and wall-time budget to S2 and I on the same seeds
resource_costs.memory: Checkpoint grows with track trajectories and plane edges; bounded fixtures remain KB–MB scale

proposal.selection_implication: Admit H into tournament only after this proposal is implemented with mechanism ablation behavioral change. Do not select H over I unless SESOI-cleared paired advantage appears under equal resources; default remains terminal_closed_null with provisional simplest kernel.

proposal.comparison_to_existing_slot: Pinned H only increments past/present/counterfactual counters and shares semantic digest with all candidates; proposed IIDCL changes state transitions and scored answers under intervention. Eligible only after this proposal is implemented and FT2–FT7 run—not by renaming the placeholder.

discriminating_ablation.name: remove_intervention_index
discriminating_ablation.null_criterion: effect 0 or CI includes 0 or below SESOI ⇒ H mechanism null; retain I as simplest sufficient.
discriminating_ablation.procedure: Keep factual event bag and projection; delete BranchStore and causal parent enforcement; causal queries fall back to last-write bags like I/S2.
discriminating_ablation.success_criterion_for_H: On preregistered FT3 bed, full H mean paired effect vs ablation ≥ SESOI 0.05 with 95% CI lower bound >0 over ≥32 histories, under equal events/tools/compute.

proposal.equal_resource_baseline: S2_task_independent_monolithic_persistent_core and I_simplest_sufficient and full_transcript_replay must receive identical event streams and compute budgets.

executable_bounded_prototype.behavior_delta_vs_placeholder: plane counters replaced by causal_index + branch_store that gate causal/counterfactual answers
executable_bounded_prototype.fixture_extension: developmental_fixture plus intervene(push=false)|observe(push=false) pair requiring distinct predictions for door-angle

resource_costs.checkpoint_growth: O(events + branches × delta_size); bound max_branches and max_events in prototype
resource_costs.cpu: O(E+V) per interventional query within cap; refuse over-budget branches
resource_costs.memory: materialized projection plus sparse branch deltas; no model weights required
resource_costs.model_calls: zero in bounded prototype; fabric optional and equal-budget if enabled

executable_bounded_prototype.runtime: pure Python, deterministic, llm_required=false, tensor_required=false, training_required=false

failure_modes: If tasks never require intervene-vs-observe, IIDCL collapses to C/I and must lose on complexity.
Incorrect parent annotation yields coherent but wrong DAGs (silent causal mis-specification).
Branch explosion under open counterfactual generation without caps.
Compilation risk: hard-coding bed-specific causal rules into transition function (same S2 hazard).
Fabric proposers could smuggle labels if admission skips held-out checks.
proposal.mechanism: Own a factual append-only event chain where each event may declare causal_parents and causal_role in {observation, action, outcome, intervention, correction}. Maintain a first-class BranchStore: each counterfactual or interventional query creates a branch anchored at base_event_id with an intervention set interpreted as do(V=v) (parents of V cut; descendants re-derived by deterministic local rules). Causal and counterfactual contract queries must walk the factual DAG or a named branch; non-causal contracts may use the ordinary projection for parity. Model fabric modules are optional proposers of candidate edges/interventions only; admissions require construction-split corroboration or explicit operator warrant and never alter identity.
proposal.name: Intervention-Indexed Dual-Timeline Causal Ledger (IIDCL)
proposal.note: Proposal is a testable architecture hypothesis only; it does not overturn terminal_closed_null or pilot mechanism_null.

state_representation.identity_core: identity, goals/unfinished_tasks, admitted knowledge, factual causal_index digests

state_representation.model_fabric_registry: replaceable model cards and routes excluded from identity semantic core

discriminating_ablation.keep_constant: event count, contracts, goals, compute budget, sensor payloads
discriminating_ablation.name: remove_spatial_intervention_index
discriminating_ablation.null_criterion: effect 0 or CI includes 0 or below SESOI => H spatial mechanism null; retain provisional I_simplest_sufficient.
discriminating_ablation.procedure: Keep factual event bag and non-spatial projection; delete branch_store spatial deltas and frame_index enforcement; pose becomes last-write labels like I/S2; interventions become annotations only.
discriminating_ablation.success_criterion_for_H: On preregistered FT-S3D-1 and FT-S3D-2 beds, full H mean paired effect vs ablation >= SESOI 0.05 with 95% CI lower bound >0 over >=32 histories; and full H vs equal-resource S2 same criterion.

bounded_fixture_sketch: Goal: keep door object identity across two depth views.
Ingest depth A then depth B with known relative camera pose; upsert one door frame; occupancy cells mark free path.
Causal edge: push -> door-angle; intervene branch door-no-push with push=false; projected_delta door-angle=0; actual door frame unchanged.
Corrupt depth B zeros; feature/frame evidence digest changes; knowledge admission of pose must refuse or raise uncertainty.
Checkpoint/restore must recover frame_index, occupancy_index, causal_index, and branch_store exactly.
executable_bounded_prototype.interfaces: identical CONTRACTS; append/query/checkpoint/restore; mechanism_decision requires intervention_index_head from branch_store+causal_index+frame_index
executable_bounded_prototype.reuse: May reuse final_revision_sensorium depth/mesh/point_cloud feature digests as observation payloads, but geometry ownership lives in H frame_index/occupancy_index/branch_store, not only perceptual memory bags.
executable_bounded_prototype.runtime: pure Python + NumPy only; llm_required=false; tensor_required=false; training_required=false; deterministic sorted digests
sketch_api: mechanism_decision includes causal_path_length, active_branch_count, frame_count, intervention_index_head

failure_modes: If tasks never require multi-view geometry or intervene-vs-observe, IISFCL collapses toward C/I and must lose on complexity_weight.
Coarse occupancy may be too weak for fine contact; or too expensive if bound max_voxels is set high without need.
Incorrect causal parent annotation yields coherent wrong rearrangements (silent geometric mis-specification).
Branch explosion without refuse over-budget on open counterfactual pose sampling.
Compilation risk: hard-coding XYZ answers into transitions (S2-style task compilation) invents spatial success without mechanism.
Decorative failure: activity receipts increment while decisions match I/S2 on spatial beds => tournament must reject H.
proposal.how_it_differs_from_existing_candidates: Not a rename of C (events without causal cuts), E (property graph without SE3/occupancy/branch projections), G (kind-prediction errors without geometric intervention), or I/S2 (flat projection). IISFCL owns object-centric SE3 frames, bounded occupancy, and a first-class branch_store where spatial interventions cut causal parents of pose/contact variables and derive branch-local geometry without actual-state writeback.

mechanism.decision_rule: Prefer actions that reduce occupancy entropy on goal-relevant objects under equal compute; refuse knowledge elevation of pose when multi-view conflict exceeds threshold without warrant.
mechanism.intervention_operator: append world operation intervene with {branch_id, variable, value, held_fixed}; parents of variable cut; descendants projected into branch_store[branch_id].projected_delta; actual_writeback=false
mechanism.summary: Maintain a factual append-only CognitiveEvent ledger. Spatial observations upsert object frames (object_id to SE3 pose, extent_xyz, optional coarse occupancy cells) and contact/support predicates. Causal edges may attach to geometric variables (pose components, contact bits) with deterministic local maps. An explicit intervention operator do(variable=value) creates a branch_store entry anchored at base_event_id, cuts incoming causal parents of the intervened variable, and re-derives only descendant geometric effects into projected_delta. Counterfactual queries must name a branch; actual projection never receives branch writeback. Decisions that claim spatial necessity must cite frame digests or branch digests; otherwise refuse over-claiming.

proposal.name: Intervention-Indexed Spatial-Frame Causal Ledger (IISFCL)
proposal.note: Architecture hypothesis only; not a primary endpoint; external activation false.

resource_costs.cpu: O(E + V + C) per interventional re-derive within caps; refuse over-budget branches
resource_costs.equal_resource_comparator: S2_task_independent_monolithic_persistent_core, I_simplest_sufficient, E_graph_dynamical, and full_transcript_replay receive identical event streams, tools, and compute budgets
resource_costs.memory: materialized projection + frame_index + coarse occupancy + sparse branch deltas; no model weights required
resource_costs.model_calls: zero in bounded prototype; model fabric optional under equal-resource budgets only
